final: SELECT e.link_to_event, e.cnt, CAST(e.cnt AS REAL) / t.tot AS quotient FROM (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM attendance GROUP BY link_to_event) e CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS tot FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM attendance GROUP BY link_to_event)) t WHERE t.tot IS NOT NULL ORDER BY quotient DESC LIMIT 10
